// diagnostic

E1310

A `...` rest parameter is not last, or a variadic parameter has a default value.

What

A `...` rest parameter is not last, or a variadic parameter has a default value.

Why

A variadic parameter collects every trailing argument, so nothing may follow it; a default would contradict that job.

Fix

Move `name: ...T` to the end of the parameter list and remove any `{…}` default.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1310: tests/ui/variadic_not_last.stderr.

Error [E1310]: variadic parameter `first` must be last
  --> tests/ui/variadic_not_last.jet:1:8
    |
  1 | fn bad(first: ...String, last: String) {
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: a `name: ...T` rest parameter collects every trailing argument, so nothing may follow it
 Fix: move `{}` to the end of the parameter list, or remove the `...`
